notes: Bow is +Z, up is +Y (matches the sloop's forward). HANDEDNESS: this hull's starboard is -X (port +X) — the OPPOSITE of the sloop (starboard +X). Use right_axis for the world side; port/starboard parts are also identified by node-name suffix (_P=port, _S=starboard) regardless of axis.
All clips are normalized poses over frame_range; scrub by normalized time for state, play for recoil.
Clips are sparse/composable: each touches only its listed targets; apply several at once.
Rudder is SYMMETRIC: 0=hard port, 0.5=center (frame 15), 1=hard starboard. Tiller is a child of Rudder and follows automatically.
Trim is SYMMETRIC for this fore-and-aft lug rig: 0=port tack, 0.5=amidships (frame 15), 1=starboard tack. Drives the MainTrim + JibTrim bones; all running rigging is skinned to them and follows.
Guns are PER SIDE (Gun_P, Gun_S): 0=STOWED (run in), 1=READY (run out over the rail). Recoil reuses this same travel — kick from ready toward stowed (~gun_recoil_m) and ease back to 1.

AnchorDrop: 0=stowed (canted in the cathead), 1=lowered. The anchor swings upright over the first ~quarter of the clip then lowers; the cable (AnchorCable morph 'Drop') pays out with it. One anchor, starboard bow.

Furl: 0=full sail, 1=furled. Furl_Main and Furl_Jib each drive the sail AND its running-rigging/clew-block morphs together so the sheets, tack and clew block rise with the sail. Morph weights can be driven directly (0..1) instead of via the Furl_* clips — see morph_targets / sail_sheet_pairs.
Flag (Flag1>Flag2>Flag3 bone chain, red ensign) has NO clip — oscillate in code (see free_rotation_bones).

MAST DAMAGE (see mast_damage): scrub 'MastDown' 0->1 by mast-zone damage (0=intact, 0.5=cracked/leaning, 1=collapsed over the side, snapping low at the deck). Ramp the 'Break' morph on Pinnace_Mast near full for the splintered snap. The whole rig topples as a unit — MainTrim (main yard+lug sail) and JibTrim (jib) bones are children of the new B_Mast hinge; the shrouds/stays were split out of the static hull into Pinnace_Mast and skinned to B_Mast with a foot->hull gradient so they drag down but stay attached at the hull. Costs +3 draws (Pinnace_Mast = SHIP_MATTE + SHIP_METAL + SHIP_GLASS masthead lantern); no new materials. Ensign staff (Flag1) is at the stern, unaffected.
Rudder, GunMount_P/S and Anchor are TRANSFORM (object) nodes, not skeleton joints; scrub their clips by name like any other.

Lantern glass is emissive (KHR_materials_emissive_strength); 3 warm point lights ship with them: Lantern_Bow_L, Lantern_Mast_L, Lantern_Stern_L. Add a glow/bloom layer. The model also animates, so prefer runtime SSAO over the lightly-baked AO.

MastDown.note: Topples the whole rig over the side, snapping low at the deck. Pair with the 'Break' morph (see mast_damage).

mast_damage.range_label: scrub MastDown 0->1 with mast damage; ramp Break 0->1 over the last ~third
mast_damage.note: Single driver from the mast HP zone: mastFrac = 1 - (masts_hp / masts_maxHp). scrub('MastDown', mastFrac) tops out leaning at 0.5 and fully collapsed at 1; setMorph('Pinnace_Mast','Break', smoothstep(0.6,1.0,mastFrac)) adds the splintered snap near the end. The rig falls as one unit (MainTrim main yard+sail and JibTrim jib bones are children of B_Mast); shrouds/stays were moved into Pinnace_Mast and skinned to B_Mast with a foot->hull gradient so they drag down but stay tied to the hull. +3 draws (Pinnace_Mast = SHIP_MATTE + SHIP_METAL + SHIP_GLASS); no new materials. Ease the scrub over ~1.5-2.5s in code so it falls rather than snapping instantly.

Flag1.suggestion: oscillate yaw a few degrees for wind

Flag3.suggestion: largest/most-delayed oscillation for a travelling-wave ripple
